mapper.select: SELECT air.id, air.class_id, acr.class_name, air.ky_category_id, kc.name as algorithm_name, kc.code as algorithm_id, air.status, air.remark, air.create_by, air.create_time, air.update_by, air.update_time FROM algorithm_id_reg air left join algorithm_cls_reg acr on air.class_id = acr.id left join ky_category kc on air.ky_category_id = kc.id Order By air.create_time desc

select acr.class_name as className, GROUP_CONCAT(kc.code ORDER BY kc.code SEPARATOR ',') as algorithms from algorithm_id_reg air left join algorithm_cls_reg acr on air.class_id = acr.id left join ky_category kc on air.ky_category_id = kc.id where air.status = 1 and acr.status = 1 group by acr.class_name
select max(kc.code) from algorithm_id_reg air left join algorithm_cls_reg acr on acr.id = air.class_id left join ky_category kc on air.ky_category_id = kc.id where air.status = 1 and acr.status = 1
